item.title: HH the Amir renews Qatar Central Bank governor’s term for five years
item.description:
HH the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al-Thani on Monday issued Amiri Decision No. 43 of 2026 renewing the term of HE Sheikh Bandar bin Mohammed bin Saoud Al-Thani as Governor of Qatar Central Bank for five years. The decision takes effect from its date of issue and is to be published in the official gazette.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/hh-the-amir-issues-amiri-decision-renewing-term-of-qatar-central-bank-governor · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738828/qatar/hh-the-amir-issues-amiri-decision-renewing-term-of-qatar-central-bank-governor · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265995/latest-news/amir-renews-term-of-qatar-central-bank-governor · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/amir-issues-decree-renewing-term-of-qatar-central-bank-governor

item.title: Al-Kaabi discusses energy cooperation with Korea’s prime minister in Seoul
item.description:
HE Saad Sherida Al-Kaabi, Minister of State for Energy Affairs, met Korean Prime Minister Han Seong-sook in Seoul on Monday to discuss energy relations and cooperation. Al-Kaabi also met Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources Kim Jung-kwan and Korea Gas Corporation (KOGAS) chief executive Hong Ui-rak to discuss expanding commercial ties between QatarEnergy and KOGAS.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/energy-minister-meets-republic-of-korea-prime-minister · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/energy-minister-meets-korean-minister-of-trade-industry-and-resources · Al Sharq https://www.al-sharq.com/article/23/11/2026/%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%82%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A · Al Sharq https://www.al-sharq.com/article/23/11/2026/%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%82%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0%D9%8A-%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%A9-%D9%83%D9%88%D8%BA%D8%A7%D8%B2

item.title: Qatar condemns drone attacks on Sudan’s capital Khartoum
item.description:
Qatar on Monday condemned drone attacks on Khartoum, including one that hit a United Nations building and caused civilian casualties. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs called the attacks a brazen breach of Sudan’s sovereignty and of the UN Charter, reaffirmed Qatar’s support for Sudan’s unity and stability, and restated its position that the conflict be resolved through dialogue and peaceful means.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/qatar-condemns-drone-attacks-on-khartoum · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/qatar-condemns-drone-attacks-on-sudanese-capital · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265998/latest-news/qatar-condemns-drone-attacks-targeting-sudanese-capital

item.title: Qatar discusses military cooperation with Italy and Syria in Doha
item.description:
Qatar Armed Forces Chief of Staff Lt Gen (Pilot) Jassim bin Mohammed Al Mannai discussed ways to strengthen military cooperation with Italian Chief of Defence Staff Gen Luciano Portolano in Doha on Monday. HE Sheikh Saoud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al-Thani, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defence Affairs, also met Syrian Defence Minister Maj Gen Murhaf Abu Qasra to discuss developing bilateral cooperation.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738832/qatar/qatar-italy-discuss-ways-to-strengthen-bilateral-military-cooperation · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/qatar-and-italy-discuss-ways-to-strengthen-bilateral-military-cooperation · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266000/latest-news/qatar-italy-discuss-ways-to-strengthen-bilateral-military-cooperation · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/deputy-pm-state-minister-for-defense-meets-syrias-defense-minister · Al Raya (QNA) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/23/%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%A8-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%88%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D9%8A%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%82%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A

item.title: Qatar Stock Exchange rises 0.76% to close at 9,977.81
item.description:
The Qatar Stock Exchange index closed on Monday up 74.94 points, or 0.76%, at 9,977.81, after falling 1.59% the previous day. Shares of 46 companies rose and 5 fell, turnover reached QR429.02mn across 38,130 trades, and market capitalisation rose to QR608.82bn.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/qse-index-closes-higher · Al Sharq (QNA) https://www.al-sharq.com/article/23/11/2026/%D9%85%D8%A4%D8%B4%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%B5%D8%A9-%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D9%8A%D8%BA%D9%84%D9%82-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%87-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B9-30

item.title: Health ministry recalls two batches of Wellvalens Carnizinc tablets
item.description:
The Ministry of Public Health on Monday announced the recall of two batches of Wellvalens Carnizinc Tablets, numbered 12.25.02 and 12.26.02. The ministry said tests at its laboratories showed the two batches did not meet quality requirements.
Sources: Al Sharq https://www.al-sharq.com/article/23/11/2026/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A8-%D8%AA%D8%B4%D8%BA%D9%8A%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B6%D8%B1-%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%84%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%B2-%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83 · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/23/%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B3%D8%AD%D8%A8-%D8%B4%D8%AD%D9%86%D8%AA%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%85%D9%86-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B6%D8%B1-%D9%88%D9%8A%D9%84%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%B2-%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%86%D9%83-%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%AF%D9%85-%D9%85%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A8%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%87%D9%85%D8%A7-%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%88%D8%AF%D8%A9

item.title: New traffic law bars settlement for four serious violations
item.description:
The Ministry of Interior on Monday listed four violations that cannot be settled under Traffic Law No. 19 of 2026, notably driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs and fleeing after an accident. It set a QR3,000 settlement for fitting devices that amplify engine noise without a permit. The law punishes pedestrians who ignore crossing signals with up to one year in prison or a fine of up to QR10,000.
Sources: Al Sharq https://www.al-sharq.com/article/23/11/2026/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%AF-4-%D9%85%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%A7-%D9%8A%D8%AC%D9%88%D8%B2-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D8%A3%D9%86%D9%87%D8%A7 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/up-to-qr10000-fine-for-pedestrians-who-ignore-crossing-signals-in-qatar

item.title: Shura Council refers unified GCC land transport law to committee
item.description:
The Shura Council, at its weekly session on Monday chaired by HE Hassan bin Abdullah Al Ghanim, referred a draft law issuing the unified law on international land transport among GCC states to its competent committee. The council also praised HH the Amir’s European tour, which covered Switzerland and Germany.
Sources: Al Sharq https://www.al-sharq.com/article/23/11/2026/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%89-%D9%8A%D8%AD%D9%8A%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B9-%D9%82%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%AD%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D9%82%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%86-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%86%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AE%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A9 · Al Raya (QNA) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/23/%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%89-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%82%D8%AF-%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B3%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%88-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1 · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265997/latest-news/shura-council-hails-amirs-european-tour

item.title: UAE unveils Mira, an AI assistant for all government services
item.description:
Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, UAE Vice President and Prime Minister, on Monday approved Mira, an AI-powered personal assistant that brings all government services into a single interface. The assistant carries out transactions on the user’s behalf and will launch in March, initially focusing on work permits, passports, health care and education.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/23/uae-unveils-government-ai-assistant-called-mira-to-boost-public-services/ · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/sheikh-mohammed-says-uae-governments-new-ai-assistant-mira-will-eliminate-need-for-multiple-platforms-1.500758155 · Emarat Al Youm https://www.emaratalyoum.com/local-section/other/2026-11-23-1.2105603

item.title: Dubai Islamic Bank shares jump 11% on Emirates Islamic merger talks
item.description:
Dubai Islamic Bank shares closed 11% higher on Monday after the lender said its board would meet on 25 November to evaluate a strategic acquisition. Bloomberg reported that Dubai officials had held preliminary talks on combining it with Emirates Islamic, the Sharia-compliant unit of Emirates NBD, with no final decision made. Emirates NBD has scheduled its own board meeting the same day.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/banking/2026/11/23/dubai-islamic-bank-shares-surge-11-on-potential-acquisition-deal/ · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/banking/dib-emirates-islamic-in-talks-for-a-merger-1.500758026

item.title: Morgan Stanley upgrades UAE equities to overweight
item.description:
Morgan Stanley on Monday upgraded UAE equities to overweight from equal-weight, joining JPMorgan. The bank cited Abu Dhabi’s expanding energy production capacity and multi-year capital spending programme, signs of recovery in Dubai’s population, tourism and traffic, and undemanding valuations.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/markets/2026/11/23/morgan-stanley-joins-jpmorgan-in-upgrading-uae-equities-to-overweight/ · Khaleej Times (Reuters) https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/morgan-stanley-joins-jp-morgan-in-turning-bullish-on-uae-equities

item.title: Houthi media says Saudi strike kills 10 in Hodeidah
item.description:
Houthi media said on Monday a Saudi strike on a building belonging to the Public Telecommunications Corporation in the western Yemeni city of Hodeidah killed 10 people and wounded more than 20. The initial toll of four dead was raised hours later, and Saudi Arabia did not immediately comment.
Sources: Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/trump-threatens-to-sink-iranian-vessels-as-us-strikes-oil-tanker-ghalibaf-calls-for-lasting-security-1.500757421 · 21 September (Houthi-affiliated) https://www.21sep.net/316052

item.title: Iran imposes scheduled power cuts as fuel crisis deepens
item.description:
Iran has begun scheduled power cuts of up to two hours for homes and businesses because of fuel shortages at power plants. President Masoud Pezeshkian appeared in a dimly lit office wearing a winter jacket to urge people to conserve energy. Israeli strikes on the South Pars field in March knocked out about 130 million cubic metres of daily processing capacity.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/11/23/iran-imposes-power-cuts-as-energy-crisis-worsens/ · Iran International https://www.iranintl.com/en/202611223193

item.title: Tehran says Hormuz can reopen quickly if the blockade is lifted
item.description:
Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei said on Monday Iran could restore security in the Strait of Hormuz “in the shortest possible time” if Washington met its commitments, including lifting the naval blockade. He said Tehran would use all available means to counter the blockade, calling it military aggression that entitles Iran to self-defence under Article 51 of the UN Charter.
Sources: Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/trump-threatens-to-sink-iranian-vessels-as-us-strikes-oil-tanker-ghalibaf-calls-for-lasting-security-1.500757421 · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/iran-says-it-will-use-all-available-means-to-counter-us-blockade

item.title: Sisi says Red Sea security is solely for littoral states
item.description:
President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi said on Monday that Red Sea security and governance are the sole responsibility of its Arab and African littoral states, at a news conference in Cairo with Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Falih Al-Zaidi. The two countries agreed to reject threats to navigation in the Gulf, Bab el-Mandeb and the Red Sea, and Sisi stressed implementing the second phase of the Gaza peace plan.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/23/3083282 · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/101148

item.title: Primary circuit equipment installed at first Dabaa reactor
item.description:
Electricity and Renewable Energy Minister Mahmoud Esmat on Monday witnessed the completion of primary circuit equipment installation for the reactor of Unit 1 at the Dabaa nuclear plant, and the start of polar crane installation in the reactor building. The minister said connecting Unit 1 to the national grid would begin at the end of 2028.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534500 · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/101135 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/23/3083283 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534532

item.title: Egyptian bourse gains EGP75bn as EGX30 rises 1.44%
item.description:
The Egyptian Exchange closed higher across the board on Monday, with the benchmark EGX30 up 1.44% at 50,711 and the EGX70 up 3.41% at 17,098. Market capitalisation gained about EGP75bn to reach EGP3.996tn, supported by buying from Arab and foreign investors.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534434 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7629646

item.title: EGP178.3bn for bread and ration subsidies in the 2026/2027 budget
item.description:
Supply and Internal Trade Minister Sherif Farouk said on Monday about EGP178.3bn has been allocated to bread and ration subsidies in the 2026/2027 budget, speaking at the International Social Protection Forum. The system serves about 24 million families, with 64.5 million people receiving subsidised bread and 57.5 million receiving rationed goods.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7629505 · Cairo Mubasher https://www.cairomubasher.com/255310 · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/101066

item.title: Share of pupils weak in reading and writing falls to 13.9%
item.description:
Education Minister Mohamed Abdel Latif said on Monday the share of pupils weak in reading and writing fell from 45.5% before the national basic skills programme to 13.9% in its third phase. The programme, run with UNICEF for grades three to six, recorded 32.4% in its second phase.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/education-schooleducation/details/2026/11/23/3083287 · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/101137

item.title: Grand Egyptian Museum welcomes 5.2 million visitors in first year
item.description:
Tourism and Antiquities Minister Sherif Fathy said on Monday the Grand Egyptian Museum received about 5.2 million visitors in its first year after opening. He made the announcement while meeting a delegation from the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), with talks covering expanded hotel capacity and staff training.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534395 · Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7191334

item.title: Gold rises EGP75 as 21-carat reaches EGP5,645
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt rose by about EGP75 from the opening level by midday on Monday, with 21-carat at about EGP5,645 a gram and 24-carat at about EGP6,451. The global price rose more than 2.3% to about $3,620 an ounce, after losing about 9% last week.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/23/3083185 · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/101006

item.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO 11 days after he resigned
item.description:
Nvidia said on Monday its board voted unanimously to reinstate co-founder Jensen Huang as chief executive and board member with immediate effect. The board said input from senior levels of the US government left it confident his return poses no national security risk. Huang resigned on 12 November, and President Donald Trump welcomed the decision.
Sources: NVIDIA (SEC filing) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000090/nov23pressrelease.htm · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/2026/11/23/nvidia-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-ceo/ · Gulf News (Reuters) https://gulfnews.com/technology/nvidia-board-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-ceo-1.500758215 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/nvidia-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-ceo-days-after-his-resignation

item.title: Wall Street surges, Nasdaq up over 7% on Huang’s return
item.description:
US stocks jumped at Monday’s open after Nvidia’s decision, with the company’s shares up more than 28%. The Nasdaq rose more than 7% and the S&P 500 more than 5%, while the Dow Jones gained 1,344 points, or 2.8%. The rebound follows a turbulent week for the AI sector over concerns about financing its build-out.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/markets/2026/11/23/nvidia-shares-nasdaq-sp-500-djia/ · 24/7 Wall St. https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/23/stock-market-today-dow-sp-500-and-nasdaq-surge-as-nvidia-leads-a-major-ai-rebound/

item.title: At least 15 killed in Russian attacks on Kyiv region
item.description:
At least 15 people were killed in Russian attacks on the Kyiv region overnight into Monday, 11 of them in a partially collapsed five-storey apartment block in the town of Dymer north of the capital. Three others were killed and 15 wounded in a strike on a supermarket in Vyshneve south of Kyiv, and rescuers are searching for 11 people, including two children.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/death-toll-rises-after-deadly-russian-attacks-on-ukraine · APA (AFP) https://en.apa.az/cis-countries/ukraine-says-russian-strikes-kill-15-in-kyiv-region-updated-537839

item.title: Bomb threat emails hit hundreds of schools in Germany and Denmark
item.description:
Hundreds of schools in Germany received emailed bomb threats on Monday, including more than 450 in Baden-Wuerttemberg alone, with police saying there was no immediate danger. Danish police investigated similar threats to several schools, after a wave of hoaxes and cyber attacks on European institutions in recent weeks.
Sources: The National (Reuters) https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/europe/2026/11/23/police-investigate-death-awaits-you-bomb-threats-in-denmark-and-germany/ · Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/bomb-threat-emails-spark-alarm-at-schools-across-germany-1.500757907

item.title: Candy factory fire in Indonesia kills 24
item.description:
Indonesian authorities confirmed on Monday that 24 people died in a fire that gutted a candy factory in Cikande, Banten province, on Saturday evening, as rescuers kept searching for more than 30 missing workers. A presidential adviser said preliminary reports pointed to a short circuit in an air-conditioner as the cause.
Sources: Al Jazeera English (Reuters) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/23/indonesian-police-remove-24-body-bags-from-factory-fire-site · Arab Times (AP) https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/indonesian-rescuers-race-to-find-34-missing-workers-after-a-deadly-candy-factory-fire/
